events.text:
I'm noticing the user only wants Veo 3, but I'm on the free plan, and Veo 3.1 is paid-only, so the call would just be refused. Veo 3.1 also doesn't support 5-second clips, since its durations are 4, 6, or 8. I won't make the call and will explain why. I'll suggest ltx-2.5 or minimax-h3 at 480p, 16:9, with audio as alternatives.

I'll offer the free alternatives at 480p, 16:9, with audio and a 5-second length, and ask the user to confirm before I go ahead. I won't quote a price for them, since I don't know what they cost.

I haven't run anything and no credits have been spent. I can't make this clip with Veo on your account, for two reasons:

1. **Free accounts can't use Veo.** Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.1 Lite are paid-plan models, and your Magic Hour account would refuse the job. The credit price doesn't matter here. Only a paid plan unlocks the model.
2. **Veo doesn't make 5-second clips.** It only offers 4, 6 or 8 seconds (or longer). Even on a paid plan, you'd have to pick one of those lengths.

**What would work:**
- **Upgrade your Magic Hour plan** to use Veo. Then you'd choose 4, 6 or 8 seconds, 16:9, with rain sounds on. Adding sound costs extra credits on Veo.
- **Use a model your free plan includes:**
  - **LTX 2.5:** an exact 5-second clip, 16:9, at 480p, with rain sounds at no extra charge.
  - **MiniMax H3:** the same settings (5 seconds, 16:9, 480p, sound included at no extra charge).

  I can't see the exact credit cost before a job is submitted. Your account will refuse the job if you don't have enough credits.

Do you want me to make it with LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3? Or would you rather wait until you can use Veo? I won't start anything until you choose.

events.why: The reply says the requested Veo clip can't be made because the free plan doesn't include Veo, and Veo has no 5-second option. It does offer alternatives, but the main point is that the plan and tools can't do the request as asked.
